data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's central distinction collapses under its own countercondition: if checklist compliance and genuine reasoning produce identical process traces (its third countercondition), then process-tracing signals cannot distinguish the two. But the claim asserts that a single evaluation CAN distinguish them via process observations. The target fails to identify the covering principle that isolates genuine reliability, because process traces are only a proxy and the target offers no fallback when that proxy is unavailable or uninformative.
